title: MCPTracer eval --json output (v1)
description: Output of `mcptracer eval <session-id> --spec <spec.toml> --json`. Bump the filename version and add a new schema on any breaking change; do not edit this file in place once published.

accuracy.description: Fraction of expected + forbidden checks satisfied; 1.0 means every expected call was found and no forbidden call occurred.

reason.description: Failure reason; null when satisfied is true.
